boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named Winona destinations on distinct nearby corridors, each with one source-backed reason to stop.

cards.title: Bloedow Bakery
cards.subtitle: East Broadway corridor · 451 E Broadway
cards.notes: Walk the East Broadway corridor to Bloedow Bakery and check the official contact page before planning a pickup or visit.
cards.short_summary: A named East Broadway bakery with current visitor information.
cards.evidence_claim: Bloedow Bakery lists its visit address as 451 East Broadway, Winona, and publishes Tuesday–Saturday hours.
cards.access_notes: Purchase required for bakery items; verify hours on the official page before going.

cards.title: Blooming Grounds Downtown
cards.subtitle: East Third Street corridor · 50 E 3rd St
cards.notes: Use the East Third Street corridor for a meal or coffee stop, and check the café’s calendar for current downtown hours.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown café with published hours and an events calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: Blooming Grounds identifies its downtown location as 50 E 3rd St and publishes its hours on its calendar page.
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks require purchase; current hours are listed by the business.

cards.title: Acoustic Café
cards.subtitle: Lafayette Street corridor · 77 Lafayette
cards.notes: Follow Lafayette Street to Acoustic Café for its coffee-and-food menu; use the official page to confirm the day’s closing time.
cards.short_summary: A named Lafayette Street café serving coffee and food.
cards.evidence_claim: Acoustic Café says it has served coffee and food since 1993 and lists its address as 77 Lafayette, Winona.
cards.access_notes: Food and beverages require purchase; the business publishes daily hours.

cards.title: Lakeview Drive Inn
cards.subtitle: East Sarnia Street corridor · 610 E Sarnia St
cards.notes: Take the East Sarnia Street corridor to the drive-in and use its official listing to confirm current events or visit details.
cards.short_summary: A named East Sarnia Street drive-in destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Lakeview Drive Inn is listed at 610 East Sarnia Street in Winona, with a direct business website and scheduled events.
cards.access_notes: Food purchases are required; event availability varies.

cards.title: Winona County History Center
cards.subtitle: Johnson Street corridor · 160 Johnson St
cards.notes: Stop on Johnson Street to see the History Center’s exhibits, then check its visit page for current galleries, access, and admission.
cards.short_summary: A historic armory building with local-history exhibits and a gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: The Winona County History Center is at 160 Johnson Street in a historic 1915 National Guard Armory and lists current exhibits.
cards.source_title: Visit Our Museums — Winona County Historical Society
cards.access_notes: Museum admission is listed as paid for adults and students, with specified free categories.

cards.title: Minnesota Marine Art Museum
cards.subtitle: Riverview Drive corridor · 800 Riverview Dr
cards.notes: Head down Riverview Drive for water-inspired art; review the museum’s current admission, accessibility, and gallery hours before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A named riverfront art museum with published visitor details.
cards.evidence_claim: Minnesota Marine Art Museum lists its location as 800 Riverview Drive and describes its collection as art inspired by water.
cards.source_title: Hours, Admission and Location — Minnesota Marine Art Museum
cards.access_notes: General admission is listed at $12, with a student rate; accessible public spaces are described on the museum page.

cards.title: Lake Park Path
cards.subtitle: Lake Park Drive corridor · Lake Winona
cards.notes: Use the Lake Park Drive corridor to join the paved Lake Park Path, then choose an East Lake, West Lake, or full-lake route.
cards.short_summary: A city-described paved route around Lake Winona.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Winona describes the Lake Winona Path as a five-mile blacktop trail circling both lake segments through Lake Park.
cards.access_notes: City describes the path for walking, skating, and cycling; yield and stay alert for other users.

cards.title: Winona Lake Park Bandshell
cards.subtitle: Lake Park Drive corridor · East Lake Winona
cards.notes: Walk Lake Park Drive to the Bandshell and check the city’s schedule for municipal-band concerts or other programmed events.
cards.short_summary: A named East Lake Winona performance structure with summer concerts.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Winona says the Bandshell on Lake Park Drive hosts weekly municipal band concerts during summer and seats over 500 people.
cards.access_notes: The surrounding park area remains public; reservations and individual event terms may differ.

cards.title: Watkins General Store
cards.subtitle: East Third Street corridor · entrance between Liberty and Chestnut
cards.notes: Enter from East Third Street to browse the museum displays on Watkins products, advertising, photos, and memorabilia.
cards.short_summary: A free-admission company museum and store with a Third Street entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: Watkins states that its Winona General Store has free admission and that the museum-and-store entrance is on East Third Street between Liberty and Chestnut.
cards.access_notes: Admission is explicitly free; retail products are optional purchases. Published hours vary by day.

cards.title: Winona Public Library
cards.subtitle: West Fifth Street corridor · 151 W 5th St
cards.notes: Use the West Fifth Street corridor for a library stop, and verify the seasonal Saturday schedule before you set out.
cards.short_summary: A named public library with published weekday and seasonal Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Winona Public Library lists its address as 151 W 5th St and publishes weekday and seasonal Saturday hours.
cards.source_title: Hours & Contact Info — Winona Public Library
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s published holiday closures and seasonal Saturday hours before visiting.
